a: IGNIITE 2026: up to $500,000 per award, ~$10M total
dt: IGNIITE 2026 concept papers closed May 29, 2026; next cycle not announced
e: Funds early-career scientists and engineers working on unconventional energy technology ideas. The 2026 call reportedly required a PhD within about 8 years and limited applicants to U.S. citizens, permanent residents and green-card applicants.
unv: ARPA-E pages did not render. Award size, eligibility and dates come from a consultant summary and the title of ARPA-E's announcement. Whether postdocs qualify and whether the program will recur are unverified.
